# Test data

- `cosign-v2.sigstore.json`: the signature of Blitz v0.6.4's `checksums.txt`, in cosign v2's older bundle (what releases before v0.6.6 have).
- `bundle-v0.3.sigstore.json`: a Sigstore bundle (v0.3) from sigstore-go's own test data (`pkg/testing/data/bundles/othername.sigstore.json`, Apache-2.0), to read one; its identity isn't Blitz's.
